article.title: David Bradford passes away
article.excerpt: David Bradford , the Princeton public finance economist, passed away last night. David was a leading scholar of public finance and was active in the world of economic policy; this included stints at Treasury and the CEA. Bruce Bartlett directs my attention to David’s seminal tax reform document , which continues to influence tax thinking to this day.
